title: Seance — privacy demo
summary: Compare stranger, recipient and auditor views of private Esmeralda payments. November 20, 2026: the creator submitted SeanceAuditorToken to First to Launch; public Ootle mainnet metadata confirms its template publication committed at 13:36:30 UTC. The creator says the app is being switched; the reviewed app text and README still identify Esmeralda, so the browser app remains labeled Testnet. The v2 searches 40 recent indexer transactions locally before asking for an ID; Ask for it anyway can disclose that ID. The saved October 20 example remains historical. November 5 read-only review returned a Commit receipt, but receipts cannot reconstruct missing encrypted bodies. The November 2 reset removed old payments and token state. Optional Sapient payments use a demo recipient with a public view key; timing, fees and spend links remain visible. The quantum discussion uses published demo keys. The retained October 31 walkthrough covers the picker and request disclosure without a wallet or payment; it does not demonstrate the planned mainnet app. This project is distinct from DevXTools’ sealed polls.
cardSummary: Compare what strangers, recipients and auditors can read from private testnet payments, including the metadata that remains public.
